plain_description: Continue is an AI coding agent that helps developers ship code faster without leaving their existing tools — VS Code, JetBrains, or terminal. It is open source, so there is no vendor lock-in or per-seat licensing fees. The bottom line: your team gets AI-assisted development that integrates where you already work.
technical_description: Continue is an open-source AI coding agent implemented in TypeScript. It runs as a VS Code extension, JetBrains plugin, and standalone CLI, connecting to local or remote language models through a configurable provider interface. The core engine manages context retrieval, code indexing, autocomplete generation, inline editing, and multi-step agent workflows, communicating with IDE hosts via a message protocol. It supports MCP (Model Context Protocol) for extensible tool integration and includes a React-based GUI rendered inside the IDE.
title: Continue
